result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but horizontally scrollable content is visibly cut off at the right edge and the bottom navigation overlays the restaurant feed.

issues.description: The third card in the “Fastest near you” row is clipped by the right screen edge, including its restaurant name and delivery-price text. The partial card may imply horizontal scrolling, but the content is not fully readable in its current state.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel has clear horizontal-scroll affordance and appropriate end padding, or adjust card sizing so visible cards do not expose truncated text.

issues.description: The category-chip row ends with a partially visible chip on the right, making the row look abruptly clipped.
issues.suggestion: Add right-side carousel padding and a clearer scroll cue, or size/space the chips so the visible viewport ends cleanly.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the restaurant feed; the next restaurant image is visibly covered/cut off behind the navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom content padding equal to the fixed navigation height so feed cards can scroll fully above the navigation.
